newsitem.title: USA: AirTouch adds 2 mln int'l cellular customers.
newsitem.headline: AirTouch adds 2 mln int'l cellular customers.

text.p: AirTouch Communications Inc said Tuesday it has doubled the number of international cellular customers in the last year, reaching about two million customers.
The number proportionately represents the share of Airtouch customers in its international ventures.
"We think it is the largest number for a U.S. company abroad," said Sam Ginn, the company's chairman and chief executive.
Airtouch, based in San Francisco, also said it expected to reach a record number of international customers in 1997, topping its current number of about 8.7 million customers.

Ginn said the growth is everywhere except Japan where Airtouch is losing out to lower-priced local competitors. The company has cellular business in 11 countries, which include eight countries in Europe as well as India, Japan and South Korea.

Ginn added that he agreed with analysts' estimates that the global market would see about 30 percent to 35 percent penetration while the U.S. market would see a 40 percent to 45 percent penetration rate by the year 2005.
The international wireless market currently is about 7 percent penetrated while the U.S. market is about 17 percent penetrated.
The company's shares were trading up 1/2 at 25-12 in midday trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
